newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Atlas Air cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Atlas Air cut to neutral.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said it cut its rating of Atlas Air Inc to neutral from outperform on Tuesday.
-- "It seems we're going to have more near-term volatility in earnings than we had assumed, and the volatility is going to last a little longer than we expected," analyst Jordan Sherman told Reuters.
-- He said the trouble stems from five 747-200 planes bought from Federal Express Corp. The planes will be in the fleet until January 1998, so the earnings volatility will last until then, he said.
-- "We still like the company a great deal on a longer term basis, it just for the near-term we will see this volatility," he said.
